quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (H1 2026 results briefing): general manager Sha Chaoqun said the DCU, fully adapted to 400-plus mainstream large models, keeps ramping at intelligent computing centers and leading internet customers and H2 2026 shipments are expected to be good, that DCU sales to commercial users are a steadily rising share, that order reserves are ample and that the next-generation Shensuan-4 is progressing smoothly; independent director Zhang Ruiping said the company is fully confident that its full-year business will keep its high-growth momentum. On margins, Sha and CFO and board secretary Xu Wenchao said gross margin depends on product mix, order type, upstream purchase costs and competition, which is intensifying, so it will fluctuate with the product mix and market; the company will counter with new higher-performance, more efficient products, finer supply-chain management and scale-driven cost control, and will control its selling-expense ratio.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO and board secretary Xu Wenchao and general manager Sha Chaoqun (H1 2026 results briefing): contract liabilities fell mainly because products were delivered in the period as contracted; AI-industry demand is relatively strong and sales are good, and prepayments of RMB 47.71 hundred million and inventory of RMB 75.18 hundred million show the company actively locking in upstream capacity and stocking up to meet customers' purchase intentions. Accounts receivable fell 10.83% from the end of 2025 while H1 revenue grew 66.52%, so Sha said there is no significant risk of a longer collection cycle, and operating cash flow will gradually turn positive as the stocked products are sold and receivables collected.
quarterly_data.figure: receivables -10.83% vs end-2025; prepayments RMB 47.71 hundred million; inventory RMB 75.18 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Independent directors Zhang Ruiping and Hu Jinwei and general manager Sha Chaoqun (H1 2026 results briefing): the DCU covers 99% of the world's non-closed-source large models and achieved Day-0 adaptation with Tencent Hunyuan Hy3 and several other model makers' releases; built on CPU+DCU co-design and its HSL bus interconnect protocol plus high-speed interconnect, Hygon has chip-to-chip, intra-node and cluster-level interconnect covering both scale-up and scale-out, which they said makes it one of the few domestic chipmakers with system-level solution capability, aimed at high-concurrency inference and private deployment of AI agents in internet, finance, biomedicine and smart manufacturing. Zhang said the CPU-to-GPU ratio is moving from the traditional 1:8 toward 1:1 or lower, giving Hygon's CPUs more incremental room than expected. The ecosystem (Guanghe organisation) will shift from scale-building and basic compatibility toward joint development and scaled deployment, CFO Xu Wenchao said.
